author: rozaru
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000015587
* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
v (P20351) Dmel

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
erroneous propagation
Unless Dmel has an unknown alternative pathway from the one used by mammals, it cannot make acetyl-CoA from L-tryptophan as it lacks kynureninase that make the intermediate metabolite for acetyl-CoA production.
title: Remove L-tryptophan catabolic process to acetyl-CoA annotation for v (P20351)

author: marcfeuermann
body: This annotation does not exist anymore. Has probably been corrected recently. So should disappear soon.
